items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 133:1
items.html: (To the question) The soul of a male comes only from MA, but there are souls that come from the Gevurot, namely from the MA of BON, for the entire BON is Gevurot. (Item 158).
